description: This file defines data models related to users in a sports live stream platform, including user roles, preferences, and authentication tokens, using Pydantic for data validation.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: Enumeration of user roles such as user, admin, and moderator.

classes.name: UserPreferences
classes.description: Model representing user preferences including favorite teams, sports, notification settings, language, and timezone.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Main user model containing user ID, email, username, role, preferences, and account status.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a new user, including email, username, password, and optional full name.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating user information, with optional fields.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Model for returning user data without sensitive information.

classes.name: TokenData
classes.description: Model representing JWT token data including access token, type, expiration, and user info.
